context: RMS AND STRENGTHS IMVEXXY are small, light pink, tear-shaped, vaginal inserts for manual placement into the vagina. IMVEXXY inserts contain 4 mcg or 10 mcg of estradiol. Each insert is imprinted in white ink on one side with "04" or "10" corresponding to the insert's dosage strength.
